summary: Expose shared atom fractions across repeated cubic cells.
objective: Compare BCC and FCC unit cells and highlight the fractions of atoms belonging to the central cell.
intent_signals: count atoms in a unit cell
example_prompts: Compare BCC and FCC unit cells and highlight the fractions of atoms belonging to the central cell.
Expand neighboring cells so I can see why a corner contributes one eighth.

entities.guidance: Use a cubic wireframe with fractional-coordinate site markers and a highlighted central cell.

entities.name: Atoms
entities.guidance: Create corner sites plus center or face sites from a unique lattice-position map.

entities.guidance: Attach 1/8 corner and 1/2 face labels and a running sum.

state_contract.model: Selected BCC/FCC site set, integer neighbor-cell extent and central-cell inclusion fractions; duplicate boundary sites merged by lattice coordinates.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Select site contribution and hide exterior portions.

invariants: BCC conventional cell accounts for two atoms; FCC accounts for four.
Neighbor expansion does not double-create a shared boundary site.
Clipping portions changes display, not lattice occupancy.
motion_guidance: Animate neighbor reveal by cell layers rather than moving lattice sites out of position.
Choose a non-overlapping display radius or state the specific contact-radius construction.
known_limits: Ideal cubic lattice illustration; no defects, thermal motion, density or material strength inferred.
Color and sphere radius are not measured atomic properties.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.

claims.statement: A conventional BCC unit cell contains two atoms; FCC contains four after accounting for shared corner and face contributions.
claims.scope: Ideal monatomic conventional cubic cells; corner sites contribute one eighth and face sites one half.

source_refs.locator: Figures 10.50–10.52 and accompanying BCC/FCC atom accounting

physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Sum central-cell fractions; ensure unique shared sites across expansion.
